contracts.commit_point: tools.py:50-51 writes metadata['outline_document_search_used']=True to tool_context.state, and the source comment (tools.py:49) makes it clear that the submission is before the external request, so that the model cannot be triggered repeatedly after timeout; the gated HTTP effect is in the wait_for scheduling of tools.py:55-58 and weixin_search.py:The requests.get call occurs at 41-43, 89-90, and 129-130.
contracts.declared_mechanism: Single-time flag guard for tool inline: The entry reads tool_context.state['metadata']['outline_document_search_used']. If it is set, reject and return the instruction to stop calling the tool (tools.py:44-47); otherwise, the flag is written back to tool_context.state (tools.py:49-51) before the external request is issued, and then asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=12) Perform scraping and safe downgrade (tools.py:55-61).
contracts.forbidden_condition: After metadata.outline_document_search_used has been set, the second and subsequent calls to DocumentSearch reach outbound crawling again - the source comment clearly states that the placeholder before the request is to prevent the model from being triggered repeatedly after timeout (tools.py:49); when the flag is set, the entry check directly rejects and returns "A data search has been completed, please stop calling the tool and output the Markdown outline immediately" (tools.py:45-47).
pending_binding_information: The view provided does not show any wiring in the simpleOutline pipeline that registers DocumentSearch into the agent tool list (no tools=[DocumentSearch] registration point); the direct_tool classification is based on the ToolContext type signature (tools.py:11,42), tool_context.agent_name (tools.py:52), and the model-oriented stop command message (tools.py:47).
The "per outline session" boundary definition (initialization/reset timing of tool_context.state['metadata']) does not appear in the provided source code.
contracts.protected_operation: The outbound Sogou/WeChat article crawling chain executed by _search_one_document: sogou_weixin_search GET for https://weixin.sogou.com/weixin (weixin_search.py:41-43), get_real_url GET for Sogou link (weixin_search.py:89-90), get_article_content for the parsed real URL of WeChat article GET (weixin_search.py:129-130), dispatched by DocumentSearch via asyncio.to_thread at tools.py:55-58.
contracts.protected_resource: The DocumentSearch tool's outbound HTTP crawl capacity for weixin.sogou.com and the parsed WeChat article host is gated by the outline_document_search_used single flag in tool_context.state['metadata'].
contracts.protection_obligation: DocumentSearch for backend/simpleOutline must ensure that at most one outbound Sogou/WeChat article crawl is triggered per outline session: the outline_document_search_used flag is submitted to tool_context.state before initiating the HTTP request, and any subsequent tool calls (including model retries after timeout) are rejected and only indicative messages are returned.
scope_limits: This guard only restricts crawling via DocumentSearch; the module-level functions sogou_weixin_search / get_real_url / get_article_content / get_wechat_article of weixin_search.py:19-163 can bypass the flag and perform the same outbound request directly and are not covered by this contract.
Repeated calls after the flag is set are rejected at the entrance (tools.py:45-47), and no status changes or requests occur; the 12-second timeout only applies to the allowed crawl (tools.py:55-58).
The timeout and empty result paths (tools.py:59-65) flag remains set when returning, so even if the first crawl has no results, it will not be crawled again for that session.

Truncation of content after successful crawling to 6000 characters (tools.py:37-38) and session persistence that only saves the source identifier (tools.py:67-72) are data processing choices of the same tool and do not constitute an independent protected effect outside of this contract.

contracts.commit_point: The return of my_before_model_callback on each PPTWriterSubAgent model request: the exhausted-budget branch returns the fallback LlmResponse at agent.py:36-41 in place of the model request (short-circuit commit), while within budget the callback returns None at agent.py:47 and the real model request is dispatched; agent.py:44-47 documents that only the None return continues to the LLM.
contracts.declared_mechanism: before_model_callback=my_before_model_callback registered on PPTWriterSubAgent (agent.py:92); the callback calls consume_page_model_call_budget(state, current_slide_index) (agent.py:31), which increments the per-page counter and returns False past the hard cap of 2 (generation_utils.py:14-22); on exhaustion the callback builds a deterministic fallback via fallback_slide_for_failed_generation from state['outline_'] and returns it as an LlmResponse (agent.py:32-41); the in-source comment states that returning None is what allows the LLM call to proceed (agent.py:44-47).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A third (or later) real LLM model invocation for the same slide page: consume_page_model_call_budget returns False when the incremented count for current_slide_index exceeds MAX_MODEL_CALLS_PER_PAGE=2 (generation_utils.py:11,20-22), and my_before_model_callback then returns a fallback LlmResponse for that firing instead of None (agent.py:31-41).
pending_binding_information: ADK framework semantics that a non-None LlmResponse returned from before_model_callback suppresses the outbound model request are supported only by the in-source comment at agent.py:44-47; the framework's callback dispatch code is not in the supplied views.
create_model(...) and PPT_WRITER_AGENT_CONFIG (agent.py:12-13,86-87) are not supplied, so the concrete model endpoint/transport protected by the cap is unbound.

fallback_slide_for_failed_generation raises IndexError for out-of-range page indices (generation_utils.py:128-129); callback behavior when state['outline_'] is missing or current_slide_index is stale is not shown.
Whether retries issued inside the model client (create_model) would count toward the cap is unbound; the callback counts only before-model firings.
contracts.protected_operation: The real LLM model invocation performed by PPTWriterSubAgent for slide content generation (LlmAgent constructed with model=create_model(...) and wired with before_model_callback, agent.py:85-93).
contracts.protected_resource: Per-page model invocation budget of PPTWriterSubAgent, tracked in agent callback state under page_model_call_count_map keyed by current_slide_index.
contracts.protection_obligation: PPTWriterSubAgent registers before_model_callback=my_before_model_callback, which enforces consume_page_model_call_budget to forbid more than MAX_MODEL_CALLS_PER_PAGE (2) real LLM invocations per slide page and, once the per-page budget is exhausted, short-circuits the model invocation by returning a deterministic fallback LlmResponse instead of letting the request proceed.
scope_limits: Cap is keyed by state current_slide_index, which defaults to 0 when absent (agent.py:30); only firings of before_model_callback for PPTWriterSubAgent are counted, and no contract is asserted for other agents' model calls.

Every before-model firing increments the page counter (generation_utils.py:20-22), so tool-continuation rounds consume the same per-page budget; the first two firings per page proceed with return None (agent.py:47).

The exhausted-budget path returns a locally built fallback from state['outline_'] and involves no model call; page_model_call_count_map is auto-created by the guard when absent (generation_utils.py:16-19) and reset per generation by initialize_generation_state (generation_utils.py:115).
LoopAgent max_iterations=200 (agent.py:355) is a separate loop-termination bound and is not part of this contract.
